commit_message:
Speed up URL percent encoding with an ASCII fast path (#5221)

Return already-valid ASCII components without percent signs directly,
avoiding percent normalization and UTF-8 byte processing for these inputs.
Keep components containing '%' on the general path to preserve escape
normalization and the existing handling of bare percent signs.

Iterate UTF-8 bytes as integers and format percent escapes only when
needed, without constructing a lookup table at import time.

Cover valid ASCII, bytes input, Unicode, lone surrogates, percent escapes,
bare percent signs, and the allowed-character containers in URL tests.
